name: Australia
shortSummary: Australia and India share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, a 2022 trade agreement, and close QUAD coordination, underpinned by one of the largest Indian student and diaspora populations in the developed world.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Australia is a key supplier of lithium and rare-earth minerals for India's clean-energy manufacturing.
Indian students form one of the largest international student cohorts in Australia.

recentDevelopments.title: ECTA implementation and critical minerals cooperation deepen
recentDevelopments.description: Implementation of the 2022 Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement continued, alongside growing critical-minerals and education cooperation.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: One of India's fastest-deepening major-power relationships, anchored by the QUAD and shared Indo-Pacific interests.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Australia establish a Strategic Partnership.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Ties are elevated to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership during a virtual summit amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

historicalEvents.title: Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA)
historicalEvents.description: An interim trade agreement enters into force, sharply reducing tariffs on a wide range of goods ahead of a fuller Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement.

agreements.name: Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement
agreements.description: Interim bilateral trade agreement significantly reducing tariffs, precursor to a fuller CECA.

defenceCooperation.name: Malabar Exercise
defenceCooperation.description: Permanent participant alongside India, the US and Japan.

trade.majorImports: Coal, gold, copper ores, critical minerals

multilateralRelations.detail: Founding member alongside the US and Japan.
